hook: AP building *₹1,200 crore* tunnel at Nagarjuna Sagar, report says
hook_b: AP building *₹1,200 crore* tunnel at Nagarjuna Sagar, report says
tldr: Namasthe Telangana reports that Andhra Pradesh is building a tunnel at Vijayapuri South to draw water from the reservoir for drinking water to Guntur, Bapatla and Palnadu, under Jal Jeevan Mission.

beats.what: The paper says phase one costs about ₹1,200 crore, with completion targeted in 8 months; AP or the Centre has not confirmed this in the report.
beats.why: AP describes it as a drinking water project; experts quoted by the paper say it could draw water even at the 510 ft dead storage level.
beats.care: Nagarjuna Sagar feeds Hyderabad's Krishna drinking water supply, so the share of Krishna water is a city issue too.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: This is one outlet's report, based on information it says it gathered; no official confirmation yet. Opposition parties criticised the Telangana government in the report.

cards.q: What should happen next on this report?

qs: Who approves projects drawing from shared Krishna reservoirs?

facts.t: The paper says the tunnel could draw water even at the *510 ft* dead storage level.

steps.e: Vijayapuri South, right side of dam

learn.t: Dead storage = water below the level normally released from a dam

watch: Any response from the Telangana or AP government, or the Krishna River Management Board.
fact: AP is digging a *₹1,200 crore* tunnel from Nagarjuna Sagar, Namasthe Telangana reports
twist: Sagar officials told the paper they had *no information* about the works.
